messages.subject: Modelling Invertebrates
parts:
Hello everyone,

I was wondering if anyone has any experience in using NicheMapR to model inverts (specifically insects). 
Is it possible/recommended using the current ectotherm model or is there a specific invert model that should be used instead?

Many thanks
Simon

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Modelling Invertebrates
parts: Hi Simon you can use the ectotherm model as is - just be sure to choose the appropriate local height in the microclimate model. There is a holometabolic DEB model that is now part of the ectotherm model (see recent paper with Maino as the lead author in Current Opinions in Insect Science for an e.g.).
